lines.text: کند برجستن بادها و امدن برف و ضباب و سختی سرما و کسادی بازارها و از تسدیس
lines.en: It indicates the blowing of winds, the coming of snow and fog, the severity of cold, and the stagnation of markets. And from the sextile,

lines.text: دلالت کند بر صلاح حال دبیران و اهل علم و استقامت احوال مشایخ و دهاقین و
lines.en: it indicates the goodness of the condition of scribes and people of knowledge, and the stability of the conditions of elders and village chiefs, and

lines.text: جستن بادهای ناخوش و از تربیع دلالت کند بر هبوب ریاح بارده و عاصفه و سرما
lines.en: the blowing of unpleasant winds. And from the square, it indicates the blowing of cold and stormy winds, and cold,

lines.text: و ظلمت هوا و مخالفت علما و اهل دین و خداوندان سلاح و از تثلیث دلالت کند بر قوة
lines.en: and the darkness of the air, and the opposition of scholars, people of religion, and masters of weapons. And from the trine, it indicates the strength of

lines.text: حال اهل علم و استقامت حال کشاورزان و اهل کشت و زرع و بسیاری فواید ایشان
lines.en: the condition of people of knowledge, the stability of the condition of farmers and people of cultivation and agriculture, and the abundance of their benefits.

lines.text: و از مقابله دلالت کند بر زیان اب چشمها و قوت حال دزدان و بریده شدن راهها و
lines.en: And from the opposition, it indicates harm to the water of springs, the strength of the condition of thieves, the cutting off of roads, and

lines.text: بسیاری سرما (اتصال قمر بعد از انصراف بعطارد در برج حمل) از مقارنه دلالت
lines.en: the abundance of cold. (The application of the Moon after separation to Mercury in the sign of Aries) From the conjunction, it indicates

lines.text: کند بر قوت حال وزراء و اهل دیانت و ظهور عدل و انصاف در میان مردمان عامه و اهل
lines.en: the strength of the condition of viziers and people of religion, and the appearance of justice and fairness among the common people and the people of

lines.text: اسواق و از تسدیس دلالت کند بر قوة حال اهل علم و روائی کارهای زراعت و از تربیع
lines.en: markets. And from the sextile, it indicates the strength of the condition of people of knowledge and the prosperity of agricultural works. And from the square,

lines.text: دلالت کند بر فوت مردی بزرگ از دبیران و متصرفان و تجار و از تثلیث دلالت کند بر
lines.en: it indicates the death of a great man among the scribes, administrators, and merchants. And from the trine, it indicates

lines.text: توسط حال اهل علم و تضاعف قدر دهاقین و سعادت احوال فضلا و از مقابله دلالت
lines.en: the mediocrity of the condition of people of knowledge, the multiplication of the value of village chiefs, and the happiness of the conditions of the learned. And from the opposition, it indicates

lines.text: کند بر مخالفت اهل علم و دین و ظهور دروغ و امانت در معاملات اسواق (بودن قمر
lines.en: the opposition of people of knowledge and religion, and the appearance of lies and [breach of] trust in market transactions. (The being of the Moon

lines.text: بعد از انصراف از اجتماع و استقبال خالی السیر واقع در برج حمل) دلالت کند بر توسط حال
lines.en: after separation from conjunction and opposition, being void of course in the sign of Aries) It indicates the mediocrity of the condition of

lines.text: ملوک و اشراف و ظهور سعادت بعضی از اهل سلاح (در برج ثور) دلالت کند بر فساد
lines.en: kings and nobles, and the appearance of happiness for some of the people of weapons. (In the sign of Taurus) It indicates the corruption of

lines.text: احوال زنان و توسط کارهای اهل مزامیر و اوتار و وقوع تحیر در میان عامه مردمان و
lines.en: the conditions of women, the mediocrity of the works of the people of flutes and strings, and the occurrence of bewilderment among the common people, and

lines.text: نیکی احوال صناعت و اعتدال هوا و ارزانی نرخها (در جوزا) دلالت کند بر توسط احوال
lines.en: the goodness of the conditions of industry, the moderation of the air, and the cheapness of prices. (In Gemini) It indicates the mediocrity of the conditions of

lines.text: زنان و میل هوا بتری و جستن بادها و تاریکی هوا (در برج سرطان) دلالت کند بر
lines.en: women, the inclination of the air to moisture, the blowing of winds, and the darkness of the air. (In the sign of Cancer) It indicates

lines.text: بسیاری خیر و سعادت در عالم و قوت احوال تجار و نیکی حال ارباب صناعت (در برج اسد)
lines.en: the abundance of goodness and happiness in the world, the strength of the conditions of merchants, and the goodness of the condition of the masters of industry. (In the sign of Leo)

lines.text: دلالت کند بر فساد حال چهارپایان و هلاك بعضی از ستوران (در برج سنبله) دلالت
lines.en: It indicates the corruption of the condition of quadrupeds and the perishing of some beasts of burden. (In the sign of Virgo) It indicates

lines.text: کند بر تباهی حال زنان و ارباب طرب و اصحاب ملاهی (در برج میزان) دلالت کند بر تباهی
lines.en: the ruin of the condition of women, the masters of joy, and the companions of amusements. (In the sign of Libra) It indicates the ruin of

lines.text: حال هوا و بیماری حیوانات و فساد حال زنان (در برج عقرب) دلالت کند بر تباهی
lines.en: the condition of the air, the illness of animals, and the corruption of the condition of women. (In the sign of Scorpio) It indicates the ruin of

lines.text: هوا و غلبه اهل شر و فساد (در برج قوس) دلالت کند بر شکستن کارها و قافله ها و
lines.en: the air and the dominance of the people of evil and corruption. (In the sign of Sagittarius) It indicates the breaking of affairs and caravans, and

lines.text: فساد حال تجار (و در برج جدی) دلالت کند بر فساد احوال وکلا و جاسوسها و پیکان
lines.en: the corruption of the condition of merchants. (And in the sign of Capricorn) It indicates the corruption of the conditions of deputies, spies, and couriers.

summary.headline: Moon After Separation in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological delineations of the Moon’s applications after separation to conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition, including effects on winds, weather, scholars, agriculture, markets, rulers, and public conditions. It also lists the Moon void of course in Aries through Capricorn, with specific predictions for women, animals, merchants, industry, caravans, and officials.
